chunks: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used the siwak frequently, but it is not obligatory, so it does not harm you to leave it for several days.”

key_terms.السِّوَاكَ: tooth-cleaning stick; siwak used for oral hygiene
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: Is using the siwak obligatory in Islam, or is it only recommended?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم frequently used the siwak, showing its recommendation and virtue. At the same time, it clarifies that siwak is not obligatory, so leaving it for some days does not incur harm or sin.
